dbe_source.recommendation: When the question asks for x, write x = value, not y = value. Watch the axis label.

lesson.concept: When the question asks for x, write x = value, not y = value. Watch the axis label.
lesson.why: This is one of the most frequent errors DBE reported for this section.

example.problem: Find the value of x for which f(x) = 1
work: Look where the graph crosses y = 1.

probe.problem: The graph crosses y = 0.5 at the point (60; 0.5). Write the value of x.

learner_message: You wrote a y-value. The question asked for the x-coordinate of the point.
